name: Appearance
author: piazza
description: Pick the desktop theme, background, bar, terminal, Neovim, Zed and herdr themes independently from one panel.

barWidget.description: One panel for every theme on the machine. The bar, terminal and Neovim can follow the desktop theme or stay on their own; Zed and herdr list the themes they ship.

schema.label: Add an Appearance entry to the Omarchy menu
schema.description: Writes style.appearance into ~/.config/omarchy/extensions/omarchy-menu.jsonc. Turning it off removes the entry.
